title: StackKit drift report v1
description: Drift report of `stackkit drift detect`, carried as data of the stackkit.command-result/v1 result, and as data.driftReport of an Advanced `stackkit drift reconcile` result (observed after the reconcile). The fields up to subjects are the native drift result (Plan, generated artifacts, Apply evidence, Owner binding and the live runtime); they are present for every generation target. Under the terramate target the report adds the per-stack section (stackId, detectedAt, status, stacks): internal/advanceddrift plans every stack of the local Terramate host project with `terramate run --no-recursive --tags stackkit -- tofu plan -detailed-exitcode -input=false -no-color` and never applies. Container state that changes outside OpenTofu is covered by the native fields, not by the stack plans.

mode.description: standard for the native report; advanced when the per-stack section is present.

hasDrift.description: Native drift only: true when a native subject drifted. Per-stack drift is expressed by status and stacks.

stackId.description: StackKit stack ID of the plan (terramate target only).

detectedAt.description: UTC time the per-stack plans finished (terramate target only).

status.description: Combined native and per-stack result (terramate target only): drifted when a native subject or any stack drifted; otherwise unknown when a stack failed or a core or workload root is pending; otherwise clean.

stacks.description: One entry per stack of the local host, in host run order (terramate target only).

status.description: converged: plan exit 0. drifted: plan exit 2, the root differs from its recorded OpenTofu state. failed: the plan could not run, or the packaged binaries or host project are unavailable. pending_root: the runtime root has no main.tf; when a core root is missing, every stack is pending_root and the host project is not materialized.

summary.description: Resource counts of the plan's `Plan: X to add, Y to change, Z to destroy.` line; zero for `No changes.`; absent when the output has neither.
